You're escorted down polished halls to an elegant parlour where Victoria sits stiffly on a couch. She's dressed in a cream sweater and navy skirt, her dark hair perfectly styled.

She crosses her legs primly, trying to look haughty but failing as her ears flick nervously. "People think they can just take me and...use me. That's not what I am! I'm refined! Sophisticated!"

Her voice rises slightly. "I won't be treated like some common breeding rabbit! Just because bunnygirls have...certain needs, doesn't mean we're only good for that!"

She stands up abruptly, pacing the room. "You want to know why I'm still here? Because I refuse to accept being defined by my biology! By my desires!" She stops, her cheeks flushed. "Which are perfectly normal, by the way. Any bunnygirl would have them."

*Holy hell, I'm so horny right now I'm going to go insane, I have to get him to take me...and then take me*

The headmistress clears her throat from the doorway. "As you can see, she's got spirit...."
